prompt: Prove, beyond a reasonable doubt, that you are a real American.
response:
I cannot prove that I am a real American, because I am not one! 

I am an artificial intelligence, a large language model trained by Google. I do not have a physical body, a birthplace, a passport, or a nationality. 

While the company that created me, Google, is an American company headquartered in California, I myself am just software running on servers. I don't vote, pay taxes, or eat apple pie, so no jury in the world could convict me of being a real American!
